campaign: Integrated validation, GUI cleanup lane: validate, harden and simplify the HTML workbench
doctrine: GUI cleanup lane (overgo_gui_cleanup), branched from master 3a331e81 on 2026-09-22. Scope: validate, harden and simplify the embedded HTML workbench (internal/server/webui and the server contracts it calls). Capability freeze enforced by structure: no new model family, workflow, optimizer or orchestration framework; rows that need native audio, speech-document admission (master row speech-document-admission) or training-loop producers stay with their owning lanes and are not carried. Baseline measured at 3a331e81: every page acceptance passes and the screens walk captures 104 states at 2 viewports in 2 colour schemes with 0 layout findings, so the order is correctness of client contracts, stream and listener lifecycle, per-tab mount health, accessibility, consolidation, then style and the four GUI improvements that consume capabilities master already serves. Every layout or interaction change is reviewed in the browser pane at desktop and phone widths in both colour schemes before landing, and its acceptance is a browser leg or Go test that fails without the change; a consolidation that removes code holds a ratchet instead. A step's machine check is set with plan -setverify; a check whose real prerequisite cannot run records UNAVAILABLE rather than a pass. Preserve the conversation-first design: flat messages, lists and separators, no cards, reachable Send/Stop, one compact model selector, mobile drawer, settings on demand, status only for progress, failure or required action; keep the same-origin client, CSP and authenticated transport. Lane cycle: merge current master (never its plan.json) before each row when master has moved, re-plan from the merged tree, execute one row, gate. The lane plan never merges into master; publishing lane commits to master needs separate owner authorization. Bind read-only reference stores with OVERGO_SMOKE_REFERENCE_STORE and OVERGO_AUDIO_REFERENCE_STORE at C:/Users/jeffm/overgo/overgodb-store; the data root and browser output stay in this worktree. Merged master 79f5dd18 on 2026-09-23 (8b77d24e): suites now run in parallel (TestSuitesRunInParallel), so every browser leg awaits the state it asserts instead of relying on serial timing, and the catalog gained an image-embedding task the workbench offers no surface for yet (row gui-declared-task-output names it rather than building one: capability freeze). Owner direction 2026-09-23: architecture that runs the system with fewer components, more efficiency and more robustness outranks features; each arch- row deletes a component (one event stream, one event hub, the route table as sole dispatcher, store reads that scale with their answer, one text turn pipeline, one tab resource primitive) and is measured before and after. The lane edits the server, serving and client stack; overgodb, the gate and the closure ledger are master's active substrates, where the lane files evidence-backed proposals instead of edits. Master merged the lane at ff9acf5f2 (78e0cb48) and the lane merged master back at 0aa9853d (7f0a84144). Master rows browser-waits-fail-fast and store-bare-record-fill own the browser-leg deadline and the bare environment record; the lane rows that named them wait before signoff and close on master's checks once a merge brings the fixes (a lane-scoped plan retires a row only by landing it). Owner direction 2026-09-23, relayed by master: one workspace lifecycle owner in the client (loading, error and empty states, cancellation, polling, subscriptions, recovery) replaces every tab's own handling, and a consolidation counts only when it deletes what it replaces, reported as net code removed and repeated work eliminated; arch-tab-resource carries it next after the event stream. Owner direction 2026-09-24: reduce the effort common GUI tasks take. The browser lane measures each common task first (gui-task-effort-baseline) and every effort row (places, one-action onboarding, approve in place, remembered settings) is judged by lowering those counts. Owner direction 2026-09-25 after a LlamaFactory review: adopt its workflow ideas in the current stack only, plain HTML, JavaScript and Go with no framework, build step or Python. Rows gui-training-live, gui-training-preview, gui-adapter-compare, gui-copy-command, gui-memory-estimate and gui-dataset-import carry them, and gui-remember-settings and gui-model-merge absorb presets and export; its optimizer zoo, distributed stacks and hand-kept model and template registries are not adopted, and its preference-loss variants (ORPO, SimPO, KTO) belong to master's training plan. Owner direction 2026-09-25: more classification decisions throughout so automation selects, orders and judges from declared kinds rather than brittle regex or text matching; the lane classifies its own tooling (webui-typed-legs, webui-census-parsed) and relayed the gate, loop, plan and evidence items to master, which owns them.

items.title: Continue a stopped or resumed conversation exactly: keep the decoded tokens in the prompt cache, store each turn's token context, and continue after Stop with the tokens an uninterrupted greedy run produces, without re-prefill

steps.title: Continue a stopped or resumed conversation exactly: keep the decoded tokens in the prompt cache, store each turn's token context, and continue after Stop with the tokens an uninterrupted greedy run produces, without re-prefill
steps.verify: test -f internal/server/response_session_test.go && go test ./internal/server -run '^TestResponsesContinueSavedSession$' -count=1 && go run ./cmd/webui-lane -run '^TestWebUIBrowser(SessionContinuation|LayoutAudit)$' -leg 'session continuation leg'
steps.rationale: Survey (2026-09-23): continuing a conversation re-prefills the previous reply because the prompt cache saves only the prompt tokens and releases the decoded tokens' state when generation returns; the cache holds one entry shared by every request, so another conversation evicts it; Stop stores only the text already sent (the stop filter's held-back text and summary reasoning are lost) and continuing re-renders the partial as a finished message. The engine's SaveSession, LoadSession and ContinueSession have no production caller and work only on the host cache, which serving does not use. Save the cache entry after decoding (every token but the pending last one), return partial ids on cancellation, store each turn's token context with its interaction, build the next turn in token space, add a continue request with a Continue control, and delete the unused session API. Acceptance: continuing after Stop produces the tokens of an uninterrupted greedy run with no re-prefill; a session from another model or sampler is refused with its reason.
